subject: Q3–Q4 hiring triage and backfill roadmap
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Recruiting Ops <talent@staffingco.io>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Q3–Q4 hiring triage and backfill roadmap

Team —

As we prep for OKR reviews and the QBR next week I want to align on a focused hiring triage so we can present a clean headcount ask to Finance and the Exec QBR. Attached is a lightweight headcount model (Q3_Q4_headcount_model.xlsx) with three scenarios (Conservative / Baseline / Accelerated). Please do the following by EOD Monday (Feb 15):

- Mark each open req as MUST-HIRE / NICE-TO-HAVE / DEFER in the shared sheet (link below).
- Flag any immediate backfills required for operational continuity (resignations, critical single-point-of-failure).
- Call out any roles that must remain open for go-to-market or platform safety reasons.

Priority for the exec packet: one-page justification per MUST-HIRE with expected impact on OKRs and projected hire date. I’ll consolidate and propose a final ask on Tue morning for sign-off.

Shared doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Q3HeadcountModel
Attachments: Q3_Q4_headcount_model.xlsx

Thanks — short and focused.

Hannah Schmitt
VP, Platform & Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Recruiting Ops <talent@staffingco.io>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:20:34 -0800
Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 hiring triage and backfill roadmap

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear ask. A couple of guardrails from People/Finance after last week's planning sync:

- We need to limit new hiring to roles that map directly to committed Q3 OKRs under Baseline. Non-OKR roles should default to DEFER.
- For any MUST-HIRE requests, please attach (a) 1-line OKR impact, (b) expected ramp time, (c) hiring band. Without those I can’t get a prioritization slot in Finance.

I pulled a quick req export and attached a summary (reqs_summary.pdf) — there are 28 open reqs across Eng, Product, GTM. My initial read: defer recruiting for non-customer-facing marketing roles and pause a couple of senior ICs until we see Q2 close.

For backfills: flag anything that would disrupt infra reliability (SRE/Infra) or revenue ops P1 flows — we will approve those first.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: reqs_summary.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 hiring triage and backfill roadmap

Thanks Hannah — quick take from Product:

- MUST-HIRE: 2x Product Managers (PM-PLG) to keep feature cadence for onboarding OKRs. These directly affect activation and time-to-first-value targets.
- BACKFILL: one senior infra engineer (ENG-415) — we had an unexpected resignation in Jan; leaving this open will create a CVR/regression risk for the runtime team.
- DEFER: exploratory ML researcher reqs tied to long-term roadmap (no immediate OKR impact).

Inline note: "Call out any roles that must remain open for go-to-market or platform safety reasons." — ENG-415 is platform safety and should be prioritized.

Markus Klein
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Recruiting Ops <talent@staffingco.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 13:02:09 -0800
Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 hiring triage and backfill roadmap

Hannah —

From Eng ops perspective, here are my inputs (pulled from the headcount model):
- Baseline scenario adds 8 roles across infra, runtime, and data platform between Apr–Sep.
- Immediate backfill required: ENG-415 (Senior Infra Engineer) — resignation effective 2/01; pager coverage impacted.
- Candidate readiness: we have 3 screened candidates for ENG-415 in pipeline; need recruiter approval to move to onsite.

Request: please greenlight the backfill for ENG-415 and allow external recruiter engagement (see Recruiting Ops thread). I’ve attached the canary approval doc used for urgent backfills (canary_approval.docx).

Aditya Rao
Director, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachment: canary_approval.docx

From: Recruiting Ops <talent@staffingco.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:10:18 -0800
Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 hiring triage and backfill roadmap

Hi team —

We can open ENG-415 to our external sourcers immediately once we have your approval to engage. Current pipeline snapshot attached (candidate_pipeline_snapshot.csv). For clarity: external engagement will incur agency fees per our existing MSA unless you route to internal talent only.

Action items we need from you:
1) Formal approval to engage external recruiters for ENG-415 (reply-all with APPROVE).
2) Confirmation of the hiring band and target close date.

Recruiting Ops
StaffingCo (partner)
Attachment: candidate_pipeline_snapshot.csv

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Recruiting Ops <talent@staffingco.io>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q3–Q4 hiring triage and backfill roadmap

Team — thanks for the fast inputs. Summary & decisions for the QBR packet: 

1) APPROVED (backfill) — ENG-415 (Senior Infra Engineer). Aditya: proceed with external engagement; Laura: please expedite band confirmation by EOD Wed.
2) APPROVED (must-hire for OKRs) — 2x PM-PLG (Markus to provide 1-line OKR impact + hire timeline by Wed morning).
3) DEFER — exploratory ML research reqs and non-customer-facing marketing roles.

Next steps (owners):
- Laura: finalize finance-ready justification docs for the 3 MUST-HIRE items (template in the sheet).
- Markus & Aditya: one-paragraph impact statements due Wed 09:00.
- Recruiting Ops: begin external outreach for ENG-415 once Laura confirms band.

I’ll consolidate into a one-page ask and circulate for Exec sign-off Thu morning. Thanks everyone — concise and decisive.

Hannah Schmitt
VP, Platform & Operations
Redwood Inference
